instruction: Tidy up my desk: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder, the mug goes on the blue coaster, notebooks go on the orange tray, and crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket. Some things are already where they belong; leave them there.

goals.evidence: pens stand upright in the magenta pen holder
the mug goes on the blue coaster
notebooks go on the orange tray
crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket
crumpled paper balls go into the red wastebasket

constraints: Do not move yellow_pen as it is already in magenta_holder.
Do not move blue_paper as it is already in red_bin.
Toss or place cyan_paper into red_bin.
task_spec.refined_instruction: Tidy the desk by moving only the misplaced items, leaving yellow_pen and blue_paper in their current positions as they are already in their designated locations. Pick up green_mug and place it on blue_coaster, place purple_book onto orange_tray, and deposit cyan_paper into red_bin. Success is verified when green_mug rests on blue_coaster, purple_book is on orange_tray, both blue_paper and cyan_paper are inside red_bin, and yellow_pen remains upright in magenta_holder.
